Q2 browser demo audio samples

The samples are original four-bar arrangements and original fictional spoken
excerpts produced for the Q2 browser demo. The spoken samples use Carnegie
Mellon Flite voices slt, rms, and awb. The samples repeat on the simulated
player timeline, with one music sample per album and a shared radio sample.
The library metadata names the example media displayed by the simulator.
The samples contain no publisher recordings or live broadcasts.

Original samples and synthesis script: web-demo/audio/ in the Q2 browser demo.
